title: Riprap profile per island, against the island's own OSM waterline

frame.description: Course frame of scripts/layline-bake-venue.mjs: ENU metres about the venue origin, rotated so +y runs up the course axis. 1 unit = 1 m.
frame.verticalNote: z is the source file's own elevation, orthometric metres, unshifted.

units.distanceM: m from the OSM ring, negative outboard

method: Class 2 and 20 ground z binned by signed distance to the island's OSM ring. Class 20, ignored ground, is kept: on a riprap rim it is the rock the classifier declined to call ground. Deck is the median of the inboard plateau; the crown is the distance whose median z peaks; the batter is the fall from the crown out to the first usable outboard bin.
caveat: An island whose OSM ring already traces the rock rather than the waterline reports a near-zero lip, because its zero sits on the crown. Compare ring vertex counts before averaging these together.

inputs.note: Every raw file behind these numbers is listed with its sha256, URL and retrieval date in provenance.json. The digests here pin the exact sets this product read: listSha256 is sha256 over the sorted `<sha256>\t<file>` lines.

osm.query: baker Q1: coastline, breakwater and crane ways/nodes over the clip disc + 1500 m
baker Q2: buildings with a height tag at or over MASS_MIN_H
baker Q5: hero anchors pinned by OSM id, plus the Signal Hill well cluster
